Spider-Man Film Achieves Significant Box Office Success in India

The film 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' has achieved substantial box office success in India, crossing the Rs 100 crore mark within its first two days of release. By its third day, the film had earned over Rs 175 crore, with one report indicating a jump of 35% and a total exceeding Rs 150 crore. By the end of its first weekend (Day 4), the film had surpassed Rs 250 crore in India, with its Hindi version alone minting nearly Rs 100 crore. Globally, the film opened to $927 million, and its North American opening was the second best ever at $355 million.
